scope: Immutable fixed13 public-input source-route simulation. No raw deletion, browser, GPU measurement or human balance/fun conclusion.
limits: Pre-registered time/player-loss/organ-total-loss Pareto and post-run requested existing score/bestCombo objectives are separate in derived/comparison.json.
SOURCE_EXHAUSTED is finite target removal; its unspent HP is neither actual damage nor TARGET_CLEARED/XP. Actual positive HP receipts and explicit quota cancellations are preserved.
An original last-budget sample at a wave transition can carry the next-wave stamp. Derived records expose this limitation; actual current-state budget assertions were retained and passed.
